cmake_minimum_required( VERSION 3.7.0 )
project( AESDK )

# ===== create build target =====
add_library(
	AESDK
	STATIC
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Util/AEFX_ArbParseHelper.c
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Util/AEFX_SuiteHelper.c
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Util/AEGP_SuiteHandler.cpp
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Util/AEGP_Utils.cpp
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Util/MissingSuiteError.cpp
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Util/Smart_Utils.cpp
)

# ===== Surpress warnings =====
target_compile_options( AESDK PRIVATE "-w" )


set( AESDK_INCLUDE
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Headers
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Headers/SP
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Util
	${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Resources
	CACHE INTERNAL "After Effects SDK Header folders"
)

#===== set header folder =====
target_include_directories(
	AESDK
	PUBLIC
	${AESDK_INCLUDE}
)

set_target_properties(
	AESDK
	PROPERTIES
	POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE
	ON
)

# ===== find PiPLtool.exe =====
if( WIN32 )
	get_filename_component(
		AFX_REZ
		Resources/PiPLtool.exe
		ABSOLUTE
		CACHE
	)
elseif( APPLE )
	find_program( AFX_REZ rez /Developer/Tools )
endif()

if(NOT AFX_REZ)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "PiPLTool.exe not found ...")
endif()


if(MSVC)
	add_definitions(-D_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
	add_definitions(-D_WINDOWS)
endif()
